name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (execute_ai / item_use), consistent with sibling executors fd2_execute_ai_offensive_spell and fd2_execute_ai_physical_attack. Accurately describes the function: it runs the AI-selected item-use action. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Execute the item-use action chosen by the enemy AI: resolve the selected item and its effect entry, run the use animation (short-range tile flash or long-range projectile), then apply the item effect.
logic_summary: Reads AI item-selection globals (ai_best_item_slot, target x/y). Resolves item_id via fd2_get_inventory_slot_item_id and stores it to data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx (active_item_id @0x53C57), then fetches the item effect entry. ctx_flag decides how the small-AOE field pItem[0x11] is used: when ctx_flag==0 pass (small_aoe==0) as flag, else pass small_aoe directly. Pans camera to caster. Branches on range_class=pItem[0x10]: <0x10 short-range -> fd2_compute_aoe_targets with AOE radius pItem[0x12]; >=0x10 long-range -> fd2_scan_chars_along_line_with_team_filter using caster pos and reach range_class-0x10. Obfuscates tile map, delays 200ms, sets battle_anim_phase=pItem[0x12]+2. Short-range plays a tile-flash via fd2_pan_cursor_to_tile_animated. Long-range faces caster to target0, plays figani intro + rising pre-cast effect, runs a 0x40..0 palette fade-out loop, linearly interpolates the projectile target tile from cursor_world position by factor (range_class-0x10) and clamps to [0,map_width-1]/[0,map_height-1], resets the tile-anim frame counter, then runs an 8-frame burst (compose_state 1..8) before re-obfuscating and panning to target0. Finally applies the effect via fd2_apply_use_effect_dispatch(caster, slot, n_targets, target_idxs), clears all-char facing, and zeroes pending_xp_credit. Ghidra body returns int 0; the C source declares void and the caller discards the value.

params.name: caster_idx
params.semantics: Runtime-char index of the acting (AI) character; used to locate the caster runtime-char record (caster_idx * RUNTIME_CHAR_SIZE = *80) for inventory slot lookup, camera/facing animation, and as the actor passed to the effect dispatcher.
params.reason: Accurate index semantics, matches sibling AI executors, no address residue.

params.name: ctx_flag
params.semantics: Context flag passed through unchanged from fd2_attack_action_dispatch. Only effect in this function: selects interpretation of the item small-AOE field pItem[0x11] when computing target set (ctx_flag==0 -> pass small_aoe==0 ? 1 : 0; else pass small_aoe).
params.reason: Name matches the established convention shared across the fd2_attack_action_dispatch / fd2_ai_score_* / fd2_execute_ai_* family for this same pass-through argument; not address residue. Renaming would only be meaningful as a family-wide change, out of scope here.

returns.semantics: C source returns void. Underlying Ghidra function returns int constant 0 (XOR EAX,EAX); the caller fd2_attack_action_dispatch discards it.

comment_original_issue: Source comment stated 'Returns 0' although the C signature is void (caller discards the int the Ghidra body returns), and omitted the ctx_flag role and the short-range vs long-range range_class branch. Refined to be accurate and to cover ctx_flag and the two animation paths.

issues.title: Stale plate note about an 'alt-entry' / extra callers corrected (not a logic bug)
issues.description: The prior Ghidra plate described an 'Alt-entry at +0x2b4 labelled L_execute_ai_item_use_alt_2b4: 2 callers (display_dialog_scene, draw_spell_selection_list)'. Verified that +0x2b4 (0x15309) is this function's epilogue (ADD ESP,0x24; POP EBP/EDI/ESI/EBX; RET). fd2_display_dialog_scene (JMP @0x164e3) and fd2_draw_spell_selection_list (Jcc @0x1cfa8) only branch into that shared return sequence (Watcom tail-merged epilogue); they are not callers or an alternate entry of the item-use logic. Plate corrected. No source/logic impact (Layer-2 rebuild does not replicate byte-level epilogue merging).
issues.evidence: read_memory(0x15309)=83 c4 24 5d 5f 5e 5b c3; get_xrefs_to(0x15309)=JMP from 0x164e3 (fd2_display_dialog_scene, body 0x15f84-0x164e7) and Jcc from 0x1cfa8 (fd2_draw_spell_selection_list, body 0x1ceed-0x1cfef); both function bodies end before 0x15309. fd2_execute_ai_item_use body = 0x15055-0x15310, single entry, single RET.

notes: Source body matches Ghidra decompilation exactly; only the comment block was refined and the Ghidra plate's stale alt-entry note corrected. Item effect entry offsets confirmed against fd2-knowledge item_entry struct (23-byte entry @0x540AC): 0x10/0x11/0x12 are the K4/K5/K6 use-effect fields, used here as range_class / small-AOE flag / AOE-radius-and-anim-phase respectively. RUNTIME_CHAR_SIZE=80 confirmed by disasm (SHL2;ADD;SHL4 = *80). C signature is void while Ghidra returns int 0 (discarded) -- not a logic concern. name_verdict=keep; no rename. No symbol or parameter names changed (per Stage-2-only rename rule).
